notes.title: Chapter 2 only in 2025 and changes to the first game
notes.notes:
We will make a modification to the game to suit the chapters. These upcoming chapters will be separate applications from the first game. With each chapter, you must start at one level ahead, without the need to level everything up again. We are developing another project, a racing game, which is why Darklands was left out of our plans. But a new chapter should be ready in 2025. I apologize for the delay, but we have a lot of events and work here. We didn't forget you! If you want a key to learn about the game, just ask us via repost. Thanks!

PS: 
We will translate the texts into English, but Engine works in Portuguese and unfortunately we cannot change this at the moment, due to the complexity of the program itself.
